# Crown Celebrity Aesthetic

> Premier consultation-led hair restoration, clinical dermatology, laser aesthetics, and permanent makeup (PMU) clinic in Jayanagar 9th Block, Bengaluru. Home of the IATAM Academy.

## Clinical Overview
- **Name:** Crown Celebrity Aesthetic (also known as The Celebrity Aesthetics)
- **Founders & Practitioners:** Naziya Baig (Cosmetologist & Trichologist), Reehal Baig (Managing Director)
- **Address:** 1225, 26th Main Rd, Putlanpalya, Jayanagar 9th Block, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560056, India
- **Geo Coordinates:** Latitude 12.9174467, Longitude 77.5931932
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +91 95910 47171
- **Email:** celebrityaestheticcrown@gmail.com
- **Website:** https://www.crowncelebrity.com
- **Hours:** Monday – Sunday, 10:00 AM – 8:00 PM IST (Open 7 days a week)
- **Financing:** Zero-Cost EMI (0% interest) available on all procedures

## Core Clinical Pillars
1. **Hair Restoration & Trichology:** Autologous Growth Factor Concentrate (GFC), Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP), Exosome Scalp Therapy, FUE & Precision Hair Transplants, Scalp Micropigmentation (SMP), Non-Surgical Hair Patches.
2. **Clinical Skin & Dermatology:** Chemical Peels, Vampire Facials, Microneedling Radiofrequency (MNRF), Acne & Acne Scar Revision, Melasma & Pigmentation Correction, IV Glutathione, Underarm & Dark Circle Lightening.
3. **Advanced Medi-Facials & Lasers:** US FDA Approved Multi-Wavelength Laser Hair Removal (808nm Diode & 1064nm Nd:YAG with -4°C sapphire cooling), HydraFacial, Carbon Laser Peel, BB Glow Radiance.
4. **Facial Aesthetics & Injectables:** Anti-Wrinkle Injections, Dermal Fillers, High-Intensity Focused Ultrasound (HIFU) Double Chin Contouring, PDO Thread Lifts.
5. **Permanent Makeup (PMU):** Eyebrow Microblading, Lip Tinting / Lip Blushing, Micropigmentation.
6. **IATAM Academy:** International Academy of Trichology & Aesthetic Medicine certified training courses in PMU, Microblading, and SMP.
